javascript: frappe.query_reports["Open Job Cards"] = { filters: [{ fieldname: "device_type", label: "Device Type", fieldtype: "Link", options: "Device Type", default: "" }] };
name: Open Job Cards
query:
SELECT
    name,
    customer_name,
    device_type,
    status,
    assigned_technician,
    estimated_cost,
    creation
FROM `tabJob Card`
WHERE status NOT IN ('Delivered', 'Cancelled')
AND (
    %(device_type)s IS NULL
    OR %(device_type)s = ''
    OR device_type = %(device_type)s
)
ORDER BY creation DESC
